title: Osiris compiler configuration
description: Project-local compiler settings. Python package metadata and dependencies belong in pyproject.toml; build, watch, and run behavior is selected by osr commands.

$schema.description: JSON Schema location used by JSON-aware editors. It does not affect compilation.

source.description: Ordered project-relative Osiris source roots. A file path below a source root determines its dotted module name.

outDir.description: Project-relative destination for complete build artifacts. It is always excluded from source discovery.

exclude.description: Project-root-relative glob patterns shared by build, watch, check, format, LSC, module discovery, and LSP. A value without glob syntax excludes that path and all descendants.

targetPython.description: Python language version used for analysis and generated code. One build targets exactly one Python version; the minimum is 3.11.

strict.description: Treat unresolved dynamic boundaries, incomplete public contracts, and unsupported configuration as errors. It does not change reader syntax.

displayLocale.description: Default BCP 47 language tag for LSP labels and documentation. It never changes binding identity or generated code. LSA uses it after an explicit --locale and before request-language detection.

agent.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible provider settings for osr lsa. Keep OSR_API_KEY in the environment or project .env, never in this object.

model.description: Provider model identifier. OSR_MODEL takes precedence.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. OSR_BASE_URL takes precedence; credentials must not be included in the URL.

wireApi.description: OpenAI-compatible wire protocol: responses calls /responses; chatCompletions calls /chat/completions. OSR_WIRE_API takes precedence.

thinking.description: Enable provider thinking mode. OSR_THINKING takes precedence. DeepSeek receives an enabled or disabled thinking object.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional provider reasoning effort. It is omitted by default. OSR_REASONING_EFFORT takes precedence.

stream.description: Request an SSE Chat Completions response and aggregate it before emitting the stable LSA JSON result. OSR_STREAM takes precedence.
